_gram:
({#yunakti, yuNkte, yuyoja, yuyuje, ayujat, ayOkzIt#},
 {#ayukta, yokzyati-te, yoktum, yukta#})
_meanings:
.²1 To join, unite, attach, connect, add; {#tamarTamiva BAratyA sutayA#}
 {#yoktumarhasi#} <ls>Ku. 6. 79</ls>; see {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} below.
.²2 To yoke, harness, put to; {#BAnuH sakfdyuktaturaNga eva#} <ls>Ś. 5. 4</ls>;
 {#tataH SvetErhayEryukte mahati syandane sTitO#} <ls>Bg. 1. 14</ls>.
.²3 To furnish or endow with; as in {#guRayukta#}.
.²4 To use, employ, apply; {#praSaste karmaRi taTA sacCabdaH pArTa yujyate#}
 <ls>Bg. 17. 26</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 204</ls>.
.²5 To appoint, set (with <ab>loc.</ab>); {#prajAsu vfttiM yamayuNkta veditum#} <ls>Ki. 1. 1</ls>.
.²6 To direct, turn or fix upon (as the mind <ab>&c.</ab>).
.²7 To concentrate oneʼs attention upon; {#manaH saMyamya maccitto yukta#}
 {#AsIta matparaH#} <ls>Bg. 6. 14</ls>; {#yuYjannevaM sadAtmAnam#} <ls n="Bg. 6.">15</ls>.
.²8 To put, place or fix on (with <ab>loc.</ab>).
.²9 To prepare, arrange, make ready, fit.
.²10 To give, bestow, confer; {#daDyakzatAdBiryuyujuH sadASizaH#} <ls>Bhāg. 10. 25. 29</ls>;
 {#ASizaM yuyuje#}.
.²11 To adhere

 or cleave to.
.²12 To enjoin, charge; {#uvAca cEnaM meDAvI yuNkzvAtmAnamiti praBo#} <ls>Mb. 15. 37. 30</ls>.
.²13 To put in, insert.
.²14 To think or meditate upon. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} ({#yujyate#})
.²1 To be joined or united with; {#ravipItajalA tapAtyaye punaroGena hi#}
 {#yujyate nadI#} <ls>Ku. 4. 44</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 17</ls>.
.²2 To get, be possessed of; {#izwEryujyeTAm#} <ls>Mv. 7</ls>; {#izwena yujyasva#}
 <ls>Ś. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 65</ls>.
.²3 To be fit or right, be proper, to suit (with <ab>loc.</ab> or <ab>gen.</ab>); {#yA yasya#}
 {#yujyate BUmikA tAM Kalu BAvena taTEva sarve vargyAH pAWitAH#} <ls>Māl. 1</ls>;
 {#trElokyasyApi praButvaM tvayi yujyate#} <ls>H. 1</ls>.
.²4 To be ready for; {#tato yudDAya yujyasva#} <ls>Bg. 2. 38</ls>, <ls n="Bg. 2.">50</ls>.
.²5 To be intent on, be absorbed in, be directed towards; {#dEvakarmaRi#}
 {#yukto hi biBartIdaM carAcaram#} <ls>Ms. 3. 75</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">14. 35</ls>; <ls>Ki. 7. 13</ls>
.²6 To be fastened or harnessed.
.²7 To adhere, to be in close contact.
.²8 To attain to, possess, obtain.
.²9 To be made ready.

.²1 To join, unite, bring together; {#paraspareRa spfhaRIyaSoBaM na cedidaM#}
 {#dvandvamayojayizyat#} <ls>R. 7. 14</ls>.
.²2 To present, give, bestow; {#carorarDArDaBAgAByAM tAmayojayatAmuBe#} <ls>R. 10. 56</ls>.
.²3 To appoint, employ, use; {#SatruBiryojayecCatrum#} <ls>Pt. 4. 17</ls>.
.²4 To turn or direct towards; {#pApAnnivArayati yojayate hitAya#} <ls>Bh. 2. 72</ls>.
.²5 To excite, urge, instigate.
.²6 To perform, achieve.
.²7 To prepare, arrange, equip.
.²8 To yoke, harness.
.²9 To apply, fix, set, place.
.²10 To furnish or endow with.
.²11 To surround.
.²12 To despise, think lightly of.
.²13 To appoint to.

To wish to join,
 yoke, give <ab>&c.</ab> --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> ({#yojati, yojayati-te#}) To unite, join,
 yoke <ab>&c.</ab>; see {#yuj#} above. --III. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> ({#yujyate#}) To concentrate
 the mind (identical with the {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} of {#yuj#} I). --IV. €10 <ab>Ā.</ab>
 ({#yojayate#}) To censure.
